environment.service: local first-party web server with two real Better Auth sessions

checks: stable 50/100/121 traversal while another actor creates
creation cutoff excludes the new issue until refresh
exact authorized totals and no duplicated IDs
private-only search returns no issue payload, title, description, identifier, count, facet or group to a nonmember
revoked private membership is checked on continuation
previously displayed private rows are discarded in the browser

additional: all six sort options in both directions
cross-team status names and canonical label grouping

canonicalPostgresBaseline.note: Full canonical issue suite before the final grouping regression case was added. The final six-case FOR-43 run below includes that regression.

finalQueryPostgres.command: FORGE_ISSUE_QUERY_TEST_DATABASE_FILE=<private connection file> bun run test:issues:postgres -- -t FOR-43

checks: loaded private rows removed on revocation

lint.scope: changed application source/scripts; remaining warnings are existing code in touched files

validation.retryNote: One existing review emoji-picker test timed out during a concurrent build/test run. Full app reruns with four workers passed; no unrelated code was changed.

acceptedDecision.source: explicit user response in the implementation chat
acceptedDecision.choice: Keep FOR-43 focused; block milestone relocation until FOR-58 provides a transactional command. Conversion and deletion share that guard.

review.method: self-review of authorization, query bounds, cursor ordering, invalidation, affected consumers and AC/AT coverage

releaseBoundary: PR review/merge and production migration/deployment remain separate
